Category averages and the checklist use each person's latest review.

fi_checklist.Checklist item: Asks how they'd do with that kind of flexibility and responsibility
Confirms they watched the company overview and that we reviewed their assessment
Asks whether they've worked performance-based pay before
Explains this is the last step in the process and sets the agenda (typical week, compensation, licensing and training)
Asks where they see themselves long term (independent or leadership)
Take-away: hiring decisions are made together (if we decide to move forward together)
Asks if they have any questions so far
Explains the weekly bonus (minimum $1,500 AP; 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%) and the Thursday paycheck
Recaps and asks if this seems like the right fit
Typical week: Tuesday-Thursday in the field (appointments, presentations, enrollments, customer service) and Friday flex day
Asks their ideal start timeline and books a specific next step with a date
Explains flexibility and work-life balance (normal business hours, own schedule, no clocking in or out)
Walks the compensation example: 50% commission, 60% advance, 40% commission account
Welcomes the candidate warmly on camera
Explains new agents work one-on-one in the field with their agency director at first
Career track: hiring for growth, promotion from within at their own pace
Training and licensing: state certification, classroom week, field certification, with the costs
Typical week: Monday in the office (leadership development, agency meeting, training, preparing for the week)
